puzzle.hint: A prophet's supplication for forgiveness, mentioning family and all believers on the Day of Judgment
puzzle.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
puzzle.verseEn: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."
